purpose: Directly validate whether the already-frozen simple Selection Core baselines behave differently across the already-frozen S5 Market States, without adding new features or continuing Industry/Supply-Chain data work.

frozen_baselines_used.N1: MOM20 TOP-k; here k=5 within the same PIT U100 used by the formal state-conditioning test
frozen_baselines_used.N2: REV5 BOTTOM-k; here k=5 within the same PIT U100

data.execution: signal after close -> next TWSE open; H20 outcome as in formal state-conditioning implementation

combined_interpretation: Market State does not merely scale all stock-selection rules in the same direction.
The frozen MOM20 baseline has a clear positive cross-sectional edge in DIFFUSE_NORMAL and essentially no edge in SYNCHRONIZED_STRESS.

The frozen REV5 baseline has essentially no edge in DIFFUSE_NORMAL and a positive average edge in SYNCHRONIZED_STRESS, but its HAC and block-bootstrap 95% intervals still include zero and the late-period delta is near zero.
Therefore the current evidence supports state-dependent selection mechanism research, but does not authorize a Stress reversal expert or any state-specific trading rule.
next_research_implication: If continuing, preregister a clean state-conditioned baseline/challenger comparison before any additional state-specific rule is created; preserve untouched prospective/OOS evidence for promotion decisions.
